text_block_list.text: Супер Крик takes it! It's a clean sweep!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Her spring woes are but a distant
memory now!
The strongest Umamusume
of them all has finally
bloomed!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer! We really did it!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I managed to bring you the Kikuka crown... Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Thanks, but this crown belongs to both of us!

text_block_list.text: Both of us...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: If the winner is the Umamusume with the strongest bond, then this victory belongs to us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You're right. It's not one of us who's won but both of us.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You've become stronger, and I've
learned to trust
you with all my heart...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
We were able to win today because we
worked
together hand in hand. This... is
a true victory.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
This victory really does feel different
from all the
others. We bask in the
sensation for a while.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Can I do that thing I
haven't had
the chance to do?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You know, the reward thing I wanted to
do during
the Sumire Stakes?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come—on this grand
stage, in
front of everyone!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hehe! Who's a good Тренер?! You are! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've finally become the

Umamusume I've always wanted to be.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you wait... And thank
you for
being so patient.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm so proud of you and how capable
you've
become.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
I should be thanking you for fostering that
strength in me!

text_block_list.text:
We've learned so much together—things
that will
make us the best of the best.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now that she's won the Kikuka Sho, I'm
sure
Super Creek has what it takes to
race among the
seniors in the Grand Prix
too!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So, what should our next goal be?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Let's head to Nakayama at the end of the year.

text_block_list.text: Nakayama?!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
...Okay. I'm a little scared, but I want to
face this
challenge with you.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Let's take on the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Phew. What took ya? Been waitin'
forever to see
those skills!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Now we've finally got a superstar lineup
for the
year-end race.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You'll be facin' the best senior racer
around, and
the uncrowned Classic
champion.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Right, Oguri?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: That's right...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm starving...
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: Gah! You're completely off topic!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик's rivals have their sights set
squarely
on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
